name: Dedicated Philippine tax & accounting staff for small/mid Illinois CPA firms (managed offshore seats) - Stage E refresh
summary: Customer = CPA-firm account renting 1-2+ dedicated, accounting-trained Philippine staff (staff accountant / tax preparer / bookkeeper), billed monthly in advance, with US account management, an IRC 7216 consent workflow and an FTC-Safeguards-ready security program. Stage E structure: pilot seats (<=6 months) as contractors with PH-counsel-reviewed agreements; from ~month 9 workers are employed by the founder's own 100%-foreign-owned Philippine export-services company (BOI-registered), which pays 13th-month, SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG and night/holiday premia. Operating profit is before founder pay.
evidence_notes: Stage E corrections: (1) base price cut from $2,400 to $2,300/seat and seats/account from 1.4 to 1.25 because compliant competitors publish $1,963 (Penbrothers PEO example), ~$2,000 (Accountant Offshore all-in), $1,260-2,760 (Sourcefit) and $2,500 (QX, SOC 2 Type II, 500+ CPA firms) [B/D, E-WS12012-S020..S022]; (2) base gross margin cut from 38% to 31% because the contractor model fails the Philippine control test for full-time dedicated seats and creates a US-PH treaty service-PE after 183 days [A, E-WS12012-S011/S013/S014] - so the base case employs workers through an own PH entity from ~month 9 with statutory costs [A/B, E-WS12012-S012/S015/S016/S034] and a $1,500/month entity-compliance line; (3) churn raised to 2.8%/month for AI-agentic 1040 prep launched by Wolters Kluwer (Oct 2026), Thomson Reuters (Dec 2025) and Black Ore (Apr 2026, marketed as an alternative to offshoring) [C/D, E-WS12012-S025..S027].

Statutory employer cost at a $1,100 (PHP 68,924 at 62.658/USD [A, E-WS12012-S019]) salary: 13th month 1/12 = $92 [A, E-WS12012-S012]; SSS employer 10% capped at MSC PHP 35,000 = ~$56 [B, E-WS12012-S015]; PhilHealth 2.5% employer = ~$28 [A, E-WS12012-S016]; Pag-IBIG PHP 200 = ~$3 [A, E-WS12012-S034]; total ~16% of salary. Correction: Stage D used ~20% ($230).

Night-shift differential 10% for hours 10pm-6am [A, E-WS12012-S013]: Chicago business hours fall mostly in that window, so US-hours seats cost ~9% more; holidays worked are paid double [A, E-WS12012-S013]. Base assumes half the seats overlap US hours (~$70/seat-month premia).

Separation pay of >=1 month per year of service applies if seats are cut for redundancy or labour-saving devices (incl. AI), with 1 month notice to worker and DOLE [A, E-WS12012-S013] - a cost the contractor model avoids but the compliant model must reserve.

IRC 7216: consent is required before tax return information goes to anyone located outside the US, even the firm's own employee [A, E-WS12012-S001]; SSNs for 1040 filers may go offshore only if both preparers keep an adequate data protection safeguard [A, E-WS12012-S002/S004]. CPA firms are 'financial institutions' under the FTC Safeguards Rule and must contractually oversee service providers [A, E-WS12012-S005]. AICPA ET 1.150.040/1.300.040/1.700.040: inform the client, supervise the provider, and have a confidentiality contract or specific consent [A, E-WS12012-S010].

Client churn: no published data (MISSING). Disintermediation precedent: a small Atlanta firm moved from a vendor to its own India EOR after vendor turnover [C, E-WS12012-S029]. 2023 MAP survey: ~25% of firms offshore, 12% planning [C, E-WS12012-S029].
Funnel conversion rates remain analyst estimates (E). Prospect universe: 1,062 active Illinois CPA firm licences, 680 in the six-county Chicago area [A, DG-S001].

Long-term drivers: BLS projects bookkeeping/accounting clerks -6% 2025-35 because software automates tasks [C, E-WS12012-S024]; small service-business SDE multiples median 2.38x (sold, 2021-25) [D, E-WS05007-S007]; recurring-revenue MSPs ~5.4x SDE [D, E-WS04014-S015].

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Security policy/WISP (Pub 4557/5708), 7216 consent templates, MSA/DPA, PH-counsel opinion on pilot contractor agreements, and a bench of 3-5 vetted candidates; no licence needed. [E; requirements A, E-WS12012-S001..S006]
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Stage C: 2-6 weeks for owner-operators [E]; CPA firms buy around busy-season planning (Aug-Dec), so 2 months base.
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified conversations with CPA-firm partners/firm administrators from outbound to the 680 Chicago-area licensed firms [A universe, DG-S001] plus ICPAS events; rate is an analyst estimate.
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Analyst estimate; proposal = role profile + candidate shortlist.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Analyst estimate for an unknown entrant against established offshore firms; trial seat lowers friction.
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Analyst estimate for a hired account executive selling to CPA firms.
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: CPA partners talk to peers (ICPAS chapters, study groups); no measured rate.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: No client-churn data published (MISSING; vendors report only worker retention - Connext 22% attrition [D, DG-S012], Cloudstaff 99.5% claim [D]). Raised from Stage D (2.5%/4%/1.5%) because agentic 1040 preparation launched in CCH Axcess (Oct 2026) [C, E-WS12012-S025], Thomson Reuters Ready to Review (Dec 2025) [D, E-WS12012-S027] and Black Ore Tax Autopilot (claims >98% autonomy; pitched as an alternative to offshoring) [C/D, E-WS12012-S026], and because firms that learn offshoring can insource via their own EOR [C, E-WS12012-S029]. Month-to-month after 90 days is the norm [D, C9-S020]; post-April downsizing adds churn.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Seats/account x price: cons 1.1 x $2,000; base 1.25 x $2,300; opt 1.5 x $2,600. Price evidence: Penbrothers PEO example $1,963, Accountant Offshore ~$2,000 all-in, Sourcefit accounting $1,260/2,010/2,760, MYCPE from $11/h (~$1,760) [D, E-WS12012-S020]; QX $2,500 staff accountant/tax preparer [B, E-WS12012-S021]; Cloud Accountant Staffing $2,700/$2,900/$3,100 [B, E-WS12012-S022]. Correction vs Stage D (1.4 x $2,400 = $3,360): first orders are usually one seat and seat expansion is already in arpc_annual_growth_pct; a new entrant without SOC 2 cannot price above QX.
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Setup/recruiting fee: Cloud Accountant Staffing $2,250 kickoff [B, E-WS12012-S022]; Penbrothers $300 setup, Sourcefit $0 [D, E-WS12012-S020]; base $600 (often waived), conservative $0.
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: Seat expansion within accounts (second seat after first busy season) plus 2-3% price; conservative = price only, as AI tools cut hours per return [C, E-WS12012-S025/S026]. Analyst estimate (E).
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Base: own-PH-entity seat at $2,300: salary $1,100 + 13th month $92 [A, E-WS12012-S012] + SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG employer ~$87 [A/B, E-WS12012-S015/S016/S034] + night/holiday premia ~$70 [A, E-WS12012-S013] + HMO $50 + equipment/MDM $80 + recruiting/backfill reserve $100 (E) = $1,579 -> 31%. Conservative: price falls to ~$2,050 against compliant $1,963-2,010 offers [D, E-WS12012-S020] with the same cost -> ~24% (an EOR bridge at $599 would be ~5% [B, DG-S004]). Optimistic: $2,600 price with lean premia -> 40%. Correction vs Stage D 38% base, which assumed contractor engagement that fails the PH control test [A, E-WS12012-S014] and creates a treaty service PE [A, E-WS12012-S011].
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: Job posting via OnlineJobs.ph $69-99/mo [B, DG-S008] plus screening time.
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Card/ACH processing, FX spreads, bad debt.
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Trial-seat discount, travel, data tools; analyst estimate.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: ICPAS/CPA-society event fees, LinkedIn, website; analyst estimate.
drivers.dso_days__source: Monthly-in-advance billing: CapActix bills fortnightly in advance; Finsmart requires 3 months' cancellation notice [D, E-WS12012-S020]; negative DSO = prepaid.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Standardization rule: smallest round amount that keeps the base-case cash balance >= 0 in every month (set by iteration on the rebuilt model).
drivers.founder_draw_per_month__source: Project Atlas standardization rule (Stage E protocol): $4,000/month from month 13 in all scenarios.
drivers.lt_growth_y6_pct__source: Offshoring adoption still rising (2023 MAP ~25% offshore + 12% planning [C, E-WS12012-S029]; 2025 MAP 29% [D, E-WS12012-S030]) but routine accounting work is shrinking: BLS -6% for bookkeeping/accounting clerks 2025-35 [C, E-WS12012-S024] and agentic 1040 tools [C, E-WS12012-S025/S026]. Base 6% = seat additions net of AI attrition; conservative 2% = price only.
drivers.lt_growth_decay__source: Analyst: growth fades as the Chicago CPA-firm base (680 licensed firms [A, DG-S001]) saturates and PE roll-ups bring captive offshore centres [D, DG-S015]; conservative fades fastest for AI substitution.
drivers.incremental_roic_pct__source: Growth capital = account-executive ramp (~4 months x $6.5k) plus recruiting bench and SOC 2 upkeep; one productive AE adds ~0.8 accounts/month x ~$720/seat-month contribution (model drivers) -> roughly 0.8x pre-tax in year one; conservative 0.4 (price compression, AI churn), optimistic 1.2.
drivers.maint_capex_pct_op__source: Asset-light: worker laptops/MDM are inside the $80/seat-month COGS stipend; maintenance capex = US laptops, security tooling refresh, PH entity systems (E).
drivers.reserve_months__source: Two months of cash costs (three conservative): customers prepay, but PH employment creates accrued 13th-month pay and separation pay of >=1 month per year of service if seats are cut for redundancy or labour-saving devices [A, E-WS12012-S013]; a 25% client loss after April would trigger both.
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Applied to operating profit before owner pay (SDE-like). Sold service businesses median 2.38x SDE, upper quartile 3.13x (BizBuySell 2021-25) [D, E-WS05007-S007]; sub-$1M MSPs with >=70% recurring revenue ~5.4x SDE [D, E-WS04014-S015]. Prepaid recurring seats argue above the service median; month-to-month terms, founder-held relationships and AI substitution argue well below MSPs -> 3.0x base, 2.0x conservative.
